user.description: Please enter the name for your Better To-do list.
user.title: Create a Better To-do list

set_task_recurrence.name: Set task recurrence
set_task_recurrence.description: Sets or clears an iCalendar RRULE recurrence rule on a specific task. When a recurring task is completed it automatically advances to the next due date.

item.name: Task UID
item.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the task to update.

rrule.name: RRULE
rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE string (e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO'). Omit or leave blank to remove recurrence.

set_task_details.name: Set task details
set_task_details.description: Sets description tags on a specific task. Tags are stored in the description field (e.g. [quantity:2] [unit:kg] [category:Meat] [repeat:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO]) so they are visible in the standard HA Tasks panel.

item.name: Task UID
item.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the task to update.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Quantity value for the [quantity:*] tag (e.g. '2'). You can still use '2 kg'; the unit is split automatically when possible. Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit value for the [unit:*] tag (e.g. 'kg'). Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category value for the [category:*] tag (e.g. 'Meat'). Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes after the tag block in description. Description help: use tags like [quantity:*] [unit:*] [category:*] [repeat:*]. Omit to leave the existing notes unchanged.
